name: PM-Kisan Samman Nidhi
benefit_summary: ₹6,000 per year paid in 3 equal installments of ₹2,000 directly via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
eligibility_criteria: Small and marginal farmer families possessing cultivable land up to 2 hectares (approx. 5 acres).

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (Shishu Micro-Loan)
benefit_summary: Collateral-free micro-business loans up to ₹50,000 for starting or expanding small enterprises.
eligibility_criteria: Non-farm, non-corporate small business owners, shopkeepers, artisans, or street vendors above 18 years of age.

name: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
benefit_summary: ₹15,000 digital e-voucher for modern toolkits + Collateral-free credit up to ₹3 Lakhs at 5% interest rate + Skill stipend.
eligibility_criteria: Traditional artisans and craftspeople working with hands and tools across 18 family-based traditional trades.

name: Ayushman Bharat - PM-JAY
benefit_summary: Health insurance coverage up to ₹5 Lakhs per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospital care.
eligibility_criteria: Low-income families identified based on Socio-Economic Caste Census (SECC) data.

name: PM Awas Yojana (Gramin)
benefit_summary: Financial assistance of ₹1.20 Lakh in plains and ₹1.30 Lakh in hilly areas for constructing a pucca house.
eligibility_criteria: Houseless families or living in kutcha/dilapidated houses in rural areas.

name: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana
benefit_summary: Subsidy up to ₹78,000 for installing rooftop solar power systems + up to 300 units of free electricity/month.
eligibility_criteria: Indian households with suitable roof space and a valid electricity connection.

name: National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP)
benefit_summary: Monthly pension ranging from ₹200 to ₹500 for elderly, widows, and persons with disabilities from BPL households.
eligibility_criteria: Aged 60 years or above, widows aged 40+, or persons with severe disabilities belonging to Below Poverty Line (BPL) families.
